title: M7: pixelelated 0.0.1
description:
## Current priority — M7.P5 component dispositions, then combined-image freeze/qualification

The owner has approved engineering firmware transfers and one reboot each for the RG35XX SP, RG SP and Retroid Pocket Nova, plus the named preparation and screenshot checks. #519's controlled RG35XX SP alignment is ACCEPTED before transfer: exact state-bound receipt, all163 protected files/recovery/credentials preserved, stale experimental records archived and automatic cloud sync disabled. Completed alignment, builds, audits and original-image qualification remain accepted; the next changed image receives its own qualification.

All three approved transfers, single reboots, installed-artifact checks, preservation comparisons and reviewed compositor frames are COMPLETE. RG35XX SP accepted15:24UTC, RG SP15:54UTC, Nova16:01UTC, followed by final preservation/frame review. Every original stage/reboot result channel is0 and actual owners exited. Both additional devices have been handed back for normal use. Those deployment/build/audit jobs have ended. The #529 VM investigation is complete; its source delta and next-candidate qualification are recorded below. Nova startup observations are retained under #344: one recovered frontend retry also occurs on the prior build; the early SMMU burst is not assigned a cause or frequency. No physical gameplay/audio claim.

### Current work in order

1. **#528 component/source dispositions, then #537/#344 combined-image delivery.** #535 open Wi-Fi, #536 ordered phone input/authentication navigation, #538 CLEAR/EFFACER and #539 browser Back are fixed, source/VM-qualified and closed. #537 saved-connection lifecycle is implemented and source-qualified; its explicit clean/retained installed-image criterion remains open. Independent Epic review through the approved Facilitator/OpenRouter/Fable5.1 xhigh call completed, and all seven #540 findings are fixed, verified and closed: completed OAuth tokens, scan selection identity, preview/preflight context, folder-creation locking, selection recovery copy, complete-name quoting and staging shutdown. Distribution `bc2dceb406` is integrated and pushed, pins published ES `c8dc72cf9e`; delivery head `849e8dd312` has successful exact-head hosted checks. Final proof:1,373 regression PASS controls;108 WebDAV+108 SFTP;26 actual-guest transactions;15 whole-script refusals; final54 build and16 reviewed repair frames in English/French640/1280. Canonical references now link111 schema1 entries, preserving original source bindings and failed/rejected evidence. No new firmware build or owner-device/cloud operation is running. #528 remains current:17 declaration gaps, per-file/vendor/prebuilt notices and ABL implementation provenance;13 scoped notices do not clear13 components. Refresh inventory for changed inputs. Independent retrieval/off-host custody is required before publication and does not prevent engineering proof builds.
2. **#344 / #493 — freeze the combined engineering source and build GENERIC_X64.** Integrated source through `849e8dd312` includes #529 readiness, #530 identity, #531 USB revision, #532 thin naming and qualified #535–539 fixes. Freeze follows firmware-affecting #528 dispositions and includes subsequent delivery commits, exact ES/splash/container/time/qualifier/source index. #537 installed-image checks require this assembly and do not block building it. The earlier conservative incremental launch budget was554GiB including100GiB reserve; remeasure actual capacity and remaining owned payloads immediately before launch. Standard watcher plus active main-agent delivery, original result channels and actual process exit checks. No build is running.
3. **#344 / #529 / #530 / #531 / #532 / #349 / #350 — qualify that image.** Installed fixes, #536 pointer/navigation and #537 connection-lifecycle regression, clean/public ROCKNIX configuration and real retained-storage behavior, standard VM suites, updated INFORMATION/identity and affected flow/branch frames, specifically paired same-model/foreign settings and running/dead-endpoint scan proof, applicable delta review. Prior cloud/audit evidence is carried only for unchanged scope. H700 then SM8550 follow if queued with their own capacity/input/qualification records; completed device operations are not replayed.
4. **#528 / #344 / #265 / #337 / #359 — publication completion.** Independent retrieval/hash verification and off-host custody; bot/runner security-custody readback; adoption/recovery/support/SSH/cloud/branding/source notes, channel separation, per-asset physical smoke and named publication authority. Public names are0.0.1-rc.N then0.0.1; no RC allocated or designated by this plan.

**#533 reconciliation:** the original18 open M7 issues and four bugs were mapped; new #535–#539 and audit #540 are dispositioned above; #537 retains the explicit combined-image gate. #534 is a preserved fixed LED-color selection, with read-only diagnosis recorded; #535 open-network password handling is now scheduled by the maintainer with the other fixes. #352 delivered; #353 automatic migration retired; #510 qualified; #354 consolidated into #344. #349/#350 retain named exact-image proof and docs; #395 moves to explicit backlog, while active supervision remains mandatory. Full disposition, original contract mapping, exact proposed pins, source-bound evidence, watcher and retirement plan: [next candidate scope](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/releases/next-candidate-scope.md).

**Completed device work:** #519 alignment and the authorized RG35XX SP, RG SP and Nova transfers/reboots/readbacks are complete. Devices are in owner use; automatic startup/game-exit sync remains off. No new physical action is authorized by this planning update.

**Parallel #511:** website/setup/ROM/BIOS guides stay in their separate Herdr lane; startup trust remains that lane's question. Local instructions work without a live site. **Personal #516:** optional residue cleanup remains separate; no bulk cloud cleanup or first sync is implied. #519 no longer awaits approval or execution.

- **#492:** H70002 and SM855003 engineering firmware and final inventories accepted; issue closed. Both use distribution `8b5113fa164ada7d002ab138b1e3a9bf795e9de5` and ES `1d76b3da7da75794066df1c089931b890304da7a`. H700 ARM244/aarch64671 and SM8550 ARM245/aarch64737 tasks completed. All original final build/acceptance channels0, actual owners/container exited. Original failed attempts remain failures. Those qualification jobs are complete; #529 is a separate startup investigation.

Qualification: [replacement18](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md), [corrected walks](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-cloud-folder-walks), [device artifacts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-device-refresh), [final inventories](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-final-inventory).

All2,327 component/profile rows (701 distinct components) map to local retained inputs:605 exact archives/9.04GB,372 Git snapshots,43 roots,439 submodule edges, frozen distribution recipes/patches and separately retained prebuilt sources. The current notice basis is `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-09-notice-scope/licence-basis-corrected.json`.13of17 have some root/scoped evidence, not13 cleared components. ABL packaging is not implementation source; LinuxLoader `4588733123554b1f7bf935b04e494e4284894546` returned404 to blitterbot. Owner source/contact question remains pending; no upstream outreach occurred. IntendedB2 remains subject to the owner's comparison (D-WORKFLOW-107); no bucket or purchase inferred.
